name: Kazakh law: the Constitution, codes, constitutional laws, laws, decrees with the force of law and normative resolutions, every dated edition, as the Adilet legal information system of the Ministry of Justice publishes them (Russian text)
label: Kazakhstan
record_note: One commit per Adilet edition, dated the day of that edition (Adilet's revision date); the first edition by the text's own commencement article where it can be read, else its adoption day. Editorial notes (Сноска, Примечание ИЗПИ) are left out. Kazakh text not yet built. Editions dated after the build day are held. Complete national coverage is not asserted.
